newsitem.title: CHINA: China mulls more oil product pipelines.
newsitem.headline: China mulls more oil product pipelines.

text.p: China is considering expanding its oil product pipeline network over the next few years, a Chinese pipeline design official said on Tuesday.

Most oil products are transported by rail tanker or by road but there was a growing demand for pipelines, said Liu Weimin, deputy president of the China Oil and Gas Pipeline Survey and Design Institute.
"There are now only 1,500 km of oil product pipelines in China," he told an energy conference.
Expansion plans would include the northeastern region around the big Daqing oilfield as well as the southern province of Guangxi and the southwestern provinces of Yunnan and Sichuan.
"One obstacle is that China has more than 100 refineries and many have limited output," he said.
He did not give a specific figure for the size of the planned expansion or say how much would be spent.
